narrative.details: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after of the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: What have you brought from the depths, champion.

mentionedItems.name: Treaty of Understanding
tooltip: "This tablet bears the personal sigils of Madoran Bronzebeard and Khardros Wildhammer. There is space for a third sigil here, but it is conspicuously absent."
